title: Shared Backend Deployment (cluster)
blockedDetail: Not a registered workpackage (no TRACK spec / ACs; /work-planning is founder-only). Founder opted to build the Deploy-half directly instead of running the 6-phase pipeline. Deploy artifacts built and validated locally (helm lint + helm template pass): Dockerfile.deploy, chart/, .github/workflows/deploy.yml. Image build is CI-only (no local Docker daemon). Infra Provisioning half (Terraform tenant, secrets, DNS) remains founder/infra-owned — see docs/deployment/shared-backend.md 'First deploy'. Do NOT pick this up as a pending pipeline workpackage.
